title: Call Bullshit
tagline: Real-time voice fact-checker that talks over you the moment you say something false.
description: A live debate referee that listens to speech via Gradium STT, dispatches claims to Tavily for web evidence every ~15 words, and uses Nebius LLM inference for claim extraction, verdict judging, and rebuttal copy. From a 'contradicted' verdict to streaming TTS correction in roughly two seconds. Built in a 5-hour Nebius x Tavily x Gradium hackathon in Berlin (May 2026).

title: RoboMind
tagline: Talk to a Unitree G1 humanoid in plain English; the LLM reasons, predicts the outcome in MuJoCo, and only acts if it's safe.
description: LLM-orchestrated robot control with a predictive world model. A Nebius Token Factory model (Qwen3-235B) reads structured robot state, returns reasoning plus an action choice and confidence, and a MuJoCo world model runs parallel rollouts to abort high-risk actions before execution. Built at a Nebius AI hackathon.

title: Teaching Robots to Dream
tagline: Command a Unitree G1 in natural language and watch a trained world model predict the next frame side-by-side with real physics.
description: A chat-driven robotics demo where typed commands are parsed by an LLM into action sequences, executed in a 500Hz MuJoCo simulation of a 29-DOF Unitree G1, and predicted in real time by a 3.3M-parameter U-Net world model with live SSIM metrics. Built for the Nebius Hackathon 2026 robotics track.

title: Vehicle Diagnostic Assistant
tagline: An AI agent that plugs into your car's OBD-II port and diagnoses issues over chat.
description: A Gradio chat agent that talks to a car's ECU through a custom-firmware ELM327 dongle exposed as an MCP server, reading live diagnostics and decoding trouble codes. LLM reasoning runs on Nebius Token Factory via langchain-nebius with Qwen3-Coder-480B. Built for the Anthropic + Gradio MCP 1st Birthday hackathon.

title: data-oncall
tagline: Page a team of agents instead of waking up your on-call engineer for data quality bugs.
description: A four-agent incident response team (Coordinator, Detective, Reality-Checker, Fixer) that uses DataHub as shared metadata memory to identify the affected dataset, trace lineage, find the gap, propose a fix, and write the postmortem back. All four roles run on Nebius (Kimi-K2-Thinking plus a fine-tuned Llama 3.1 8B + LoRA), OpenAI-compatible. Built at the DataHub x Nebius hackathon at EF SF, April 2026.

title: Cross-Source Join Advisor
tagline: Automatically test every join across data sources and flag the risky ones before anyone writes a query.
description: Reads dataset schemas from DataHub and uses Nebius (DeepSeek-R1-0528) to identify join candidates by reasoning over column naming and data types, then classifies each join as SAFE/RISKY/UNSAFE with Llama-3.3-70B and writes the documented connections back into DataHub. Built at the DataHub x Nebius hackathon at Entrepreneurs First SF, April 2026.

title: Metadata Incident Copilot
tagline: A metadata-grounded copilot that makes safer incident recommendations because DataHub context changes the answer.
description: Ingests a Jira data incident, sanitizes ticket content locally, enriches it with bounded DataHub metadata (ownership, lineage, governance), then runs analysis through a Nebius OpenAI-compatible model endpoint and writes back a safer internal recommendation. Built at the DataHub x Nebius hackathon, April 2026.

title: VirallForge
tagline: A canvas-based AI workspace for generating platform-optimized social content with live web context.
description: A visual workflow for building and refining campaign content: configure platform, audience, and template, then generate copy and media. Uses Tavily for live web research and reference extraction, alongside Gemini/Veo for image and video generation and Gradium for voiceover. Built at the Big Berlin Hack on the AI-agents-for-video track.

title: Sora the Explorer
tagline: A voice-powered language-learning roguelike: speak Spanish, survive the dungeon, watch the AI pipeline light up.
description: A browser game where spoken Spanish drives a dungeon-crawler, with the AI pipeline visualized live. Uses Tavily for cultural and lore context with citation proof-chips for the jury, alongside Pioneer/Fastino, fal, SLNG, and Gradium voice. Built for the {Tech: Europe} Paris AI Hackathon.

title: Intelli-Credit
tagline: An AI credit appraisal engine that reads financials, researches the company on the web, and writes a bank-grade memo in minutes.
description: Reads a company's financial documents, researches it live on the web, scores creditworthiness, and generates a professional Credit Appraisal Memo in under five minutes. A dedicated Tavily web research agent (researcher.py) handles the live-web grounding. Built as a hackathon project.

title: Autonomix
tagline: An autonomous multi-agent codebase intelligence engine with live CVE security analysis.
description: A multi-agent engine that analyzes codebases, with a dedicated security agent that runs Tavily CVE search and NVD/GitHub Advisory lookups for live vulnerability intelligence. Built for the Autonomous Agents Hackathon.

title: Alan
tagline: A real-time voice AI assistant for healthcare with streaming STT, RAG medical lookup, and TTS in one session.
description: Streams browser audio over WebSocket to a Cloudflare Durable Object orchestrating Mistral Voxtral transcription, conversational LLM turns, RAG medical-record lookup over ChromaDB Cloud, and ElevenLabs playback. Nebius Token Factory (Kimi K2.5, OpenAI-compatible API) powers LLM inference for the RAG seed-data generation. Built at a Mistral AI hackathon.

title: Claim Verifier (MongoDB x Tavily)
tagline: A FastAPI agent that verifies claims by orchestrating Tavily MCP search plus LLM reasoning.
description: Wraps LastMile's mcp-agent and exposes a /verify endpoint that orchestrates Tavily MCP search/extract tools to fetch reputable sources, then reasons over them with an augmented LLM. Built at the MongoDB + Tavily + MCP-Agent NYC hackathon, November 2025.

title: FlightBrief AI
tagline: An AI flight-briefing app that earned a top-5 finish at the localhost AI hackathon.
description: Generates pilot-style flight briefings using Nebius AI Studio for LLM inference. Placed top 5 at the localhost AI hackathon.

title: Whitespace
tagline: Collect brand knowledge with Tavily, then surface and rank high-intent search triggers before ad testing.
description: An online tool that uses Tavily crawl and extract to collect brand knowledge, simulates realistic user prompts, and ranks high-intent search triggers in a dashboard for review before ad testing. Built for the Cursor AdTech Hackathon.

title: AirReserve
tagline: Real-time flight booking and price tracking; won Best Use of Tavily at AI Tinkerers Ottawa's Vibe Code Hackathon.
description: A flight search and price-tracking platform that uses the Tavily API to crawl live flight prices from multiple sources, with ambient LangChain agents for background price monitoring. Awarded Best Use of Tavily ($2000) at Ottawa's largest Vibe Code Hackathon by AI Tinkerers Ottawa.

title: Deep Research MCP Studio
tagline: A TypeScript MCP deep-research agent that turns a query into a cited report, a mindmap, and a two-voice audio podcast.
description: An autonomous multi-agent deep-research pipeline with an Astro SSR dashboard that integrates the Tavily Search API for recursive web research, synthesizes structured reports, renders Mermaid.js mindmaps, and produces two-voice audio podcasts via Gradium, delivering media to Mattermost. Built around the Nebius x Tavily x Gradium ecosystem (Berlin, May 2026).
